theorems.name: Submission.rsd_constant_multiplicity_reduction
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (z₀ : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ N → BoundaryVanishes T → R.Represents T → 0 < r → ball z₀ r ⊆ U → 0 < N₀ → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ ball z₀ r → R.mult x = N₀) → z₀ ∈ T.support → HasMassDensity T z₀ N₀ → ∃ T₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (ball z₀ r) n, IsMinimizingIn T₀ (ball z₀ r ∩ N) ∧ T₀.support ⊆ N ∧ BoundaryVanishes T₀ ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W (ball z₀ r) → T₀.massOn W < ∞) ∧ z₀ ∈ T₀.support ∧ HasMassDensity T₀ z₀ 1 ∧ (z₀ ∈ regularSet T₀ → z₀ ∈ regularSet T)
